results.name: Fuel Pump Station (Damaged & Derelict)
results.description:
Generate a futuristic, derelict fuel pump station, isolated as a floating 3D asset with no background, designed for a dystopian, industrial setting. The station should feel partially functional but severely worn, as if scavenged and kept alive by necessity.

Key Features:

Large, armored fuel pump unit with screen, flickering indicators, and dragging hoses.

Industrial metal body with rust streaks, scorch marks, and welded patches.

Torn warning decals, faded hazard signs, and analog meters stuck in place.

Floor unit partially lifted or leaning, with a power relay or battery dock exposed.

Optional remnants: broken nozzles, empty canisters, or wiring pulled loose.

results.name: Parking Garage Intercom Pillar Scan
results.description:
High-Fidelity Raw Scan (1M+ Tris) - Nanite Ready

A raw, high-poly photogrammetry scan of a concrete parking pillar or entrance column. The asset features a yellow reflective location sign ("514") and a mounted white plate containing an intercom/call box and a damaged access control housing.

The surface shows realistic water staining and urban grime. Ideal for populating parking structures, security checkpoints, or back-alley entrances in Unreal Engine 5.

Asset Details:

    Security Props: Vintage intercom button and broken card reader box.

    Signage: High-vis yellow column number.

    Note: The rear/left edges contain scan artifacts and are intended to be embedded in a wall or obscured.

Technical Specs:

    Texture: 4096x4096 (4K)

    Polys: ~1,000,000 (Source Data)

    Maps: Albedo, Normal, Roughness, AO.
